question: Do the established block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 subject-source readers jointly mediate nearly all of the fresh block8H1 cue-writer effect?

frozen_design.population: all 32 A1 and 32 A2 fresh-cue rows
frozen_design.writer: cue-source response of block8H1 at the two subject-onset destinations
frozen_design.reader9: live block9 H1/H4 final-query P[k]V[k] terms from the subject-onset sources
frozen_design.reader11: live block11 H3 final-query P[k]V[k] terms from the subject-onset sources
frozen_design.ordering: writer hook, then dynamic block9 clamp, then dynamic block11 clamp in one native forward

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_multi_: all authorities pass, capture and live attention reconstruction errors <=5e-4, base double self-clamp scored-logit error <=1e-4
predictions.pred_b_writer_effect_recurrence: writer-only mean recovery is within 0.03 of 0.17216 A1 and 0.11321 A2, donorward fraction 1.0
predictions.pred_c_each_reader_is_material: clamping block9 or block11 subject terms alone retains <=0.70 of writer recovery in each family
predictions.pred_d_joint_readers_are_nearly_complete: clamping both subject readers retains <=0.15 of writer recovery in A1 and A2
predictions.pred_e_joint_path_is_source_selective: clamping both non-subject complements retains >=0.90 of writer recovery in A1 and A2
predictions.pred_f_exact_zero_fit_price: 20 forwards, 640 example evaluations, 384 unique arm-row records, zero fits/backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, reconstruction, self-clamp, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.null: valid writer recurrence but either established reader is not material under the joint instrument

interpretation_limits: A pass establishes response mediation of this exact writer effect, not general necessity for all temporal behavior.
The reader clamps are source-term counterfactuals at native head boundaries; they do not use DAS or fitted directions.
A joint residual above 15% licenses another downstream-consumer search rather than threshold repair.
